messages:
nina: starting RC-2026.9 origination. artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/rcs/2026.9.tgz. requesting pin and quick staging smoke.

deploy-bot: build rc-2026.9 (b-1203) uploaded :package: sha256=deadbeef00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff00112233445566778899aabb

sam: pulling to staging for smoke. quick FYI: release-notes draft references migration "2026.8-migrate" which is not in these artifacts, can we confirm?

nina: good catch, hold promotions until we reconcile docs vs artifacts. sam can you verify artifact content list?

sam: listing tar: contains bin/service, migrations/migrate-2026.9.sql, docs/release-notes-2026.9.md. release-notes web draft must have stale link. I will update docs and republish.

lena: suggest we still create pin but don't promote until docs fixed. keeps pipeline traceable.

deploy-bot: pin created by nina -> pin-id: pin-rc-6412. pin status: PENDING_PROMOTE.

nina: docs updated, verified header now references migrate-2026.9.sql. ready to run staging smoke. executing promote to staging (no prod canary yet).

/deploy promote --pin pin-rc-6412 --stage staging --smoke smoke-basic

deploy-bot: staging deploy started. smoke running (10 checks).

[smoke results]

sam: smoke 10/10 passed. checks green. staging logs show service starting with model version v2.7.

nina: approving canary plan: 2% for 15m -> 25% 10m -> full. oncall-sheriff watching first window.

oncall-sheriff: watching. abort conditions: any host running mismatched model binary OR error rate >0.6%

nina: promoting to canary now:
/deploy promote --pin pin-rc-6412 --canary 2% --canary-duration 15m --tag rc-2026.9

deploy-bot: Promotion started. canary targets provisioned (6 hosts). routing configured.

[5m into canary]

sam: alert: 2/6 canary hosts reporting model binary v2.6 (expected v2.7). deployment agent shows image tag mismatch: `image: redwood/service:v2.6` on nodes a3 and b4.

lena: that's bad. could be daemonset or older node cache. suggest abort and investigate image registry caching and node-level pulls.

oncall-sheriff: aborting canary and rolling back to stable-2026.8. abort command issued.

deploy-bot: rollback executed by oncall-sheriff. traffic restored to stable-2026.8. canary aborted. incident INC-2026-115 opened: mixed model version in canary nodes.

nina: blocking further promotions for this RC until we root cause image/tag drift. tagging @infra and @eng-runtime. will update release board to "blocked" and attach incident.

sam: immediate next step: run `cictl node-image-audit --cluster prod-canary` to list nodes with stale images and drain them before next attempt.

lena: agreed. also re-run canary with smaller initial surface area after drains.

oncall-sheriff: closing thread. follow incident INC-2026-115 for remediation and reattempt schedule.
